entries.reason: Scope: the Teams BROWSER journey only. Microsoft coverage itself runs and passes in CI -- mailbox, calendar with outage/permission/throttling recovery, OAuth rejection and webhook validation in the production browser lane, the NextAuth callback lane, and 86 wire-level Graph cases including Teams bot adapters, meeting adapters and organizer routing. What cannot run is the browser journey specifically: Teams emulator overrides are denied under NODE_ENV=production by design (ee/packages/microsoft-teams/src/lib/teams/emulatorMode.ts), since they decide where the bot secret is POSTed and whose JWTs are accepted, so this journey needs a Next development server. That server compiles an 81.7MB app/msp/layout chunk, crosses Next's used_heap > 0.8 * heap_size_limit threshold and restarts mid-response, delivering a truncated HTTP 200 body the browser rejects with SyntaxError/ChunkLoadError. The lane already runs at --max-old-space-size=12288, so no headroom remains on a hosted runner. The guard must not be relaxed to clear this. Tracked as F034/T028; the durable fix is reducing the layout chunk or resolving Graph and login endpoints from tenant configuration so a production build can be used.
